baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction رآه بالأفق المبين joins an act of seeing to a far boundary qualified by manifest clarity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sensory or insightful perception reaches a distant edge, while مبين makes that edge an active site of appearance rather than neutral scenery. Observer, seen object, limit, and disclosure form one evidentiary event.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight perception supplies the act of apprehension and makes the model evidentiary rather than merely locative.
The distant edge of sky or earth supplies the limiting field at which the apprehension occurs.
Becoming visible and clear turns the horizon from backdrop into the disclosure surface of the seen object.

changed_reading.before: He happened to see him against a clear skyline.
changed_reading.after: The sighting is authenticated at the far limit of visibility, where the boundary itself participates in making the seen presence unmistakable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object pronoun in رآه and the prepositional placement بالأفق permit a relation between two parties within one visible field.
baseline_models.mechanism: The seeing-root can picture mutual visibility and facing, while its causative image adds deliberate showing. Joined to the horizon and sign-disclosing مبين, the scene becomes a presentation or encounter, not a unilateral glimpse.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility and facing supply a two-sided encounter within visible range.
Showing and making seen add the possibility that the appearance is presented, not merely caught by chance.
The far horizon gives the parties a shared but extended field of encounter.
Disclosure through a sign makes the visible placement communicative as well as optical.

changed_reading.before: A viewer detects a distant figure.
changed_reading.after: A figure is presented into a shared line of sight, and the horizon operates as a readable sign through which the encounter faces the viewer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الأفق المبين combines a limit-word with a clarity-word, while رآه asserts successful perception across that placement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The horizon inventory joins reaching an utmost degree to the clear word's images of separation and a wide gap. Clarity can therefore be discriminative: the seen presence stands apart precisely at maximal extension.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the utmost and surpassing intensifies the horizon from an ordinary edge into an extreme limit.
Distance and a wide gap supply the scale across which the sight remains successful.
Separation and parting make clarity a matter of the figure standing distinctly apart from its field.
Actual perception holds the extreme distance and discriminative separation together as an accomplished sighting.

changed_reading.before: The adjective only says that the skyline was clear.
changed_reading.after: The uttermost gap becomes a test of perception, and the figure's distinctness across that gap is part of what makes the sighting forceful.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رآه is the sole event predicate, and its focus inventory includes dream vision and a spirit-familiar encounter alongside ordinary seeing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clear external horizon can spatialize a non-ordinary vision, allowing a liminal reading to coexist with ocular seeing. The explicit horizon keeps this anchored as an appearance in a field, not an unlocated theme.

activation_trace.role: Dream vision opens a non-ordinary mode of seeing without cancelling the verse's perception predicate.
The spirit-familiar image supplies a strange personal-appearance alternative that later context can test.
The distant horizon contains the visionary possibility within an explicit spatial anchor.
Manifest appearance prevents the model from becoming merely an inward dream-theme.

changed_reading.before: The line records only an ordinary visual observation.
changed_reading.after: The line can initially carry a liminal or visionary encounter made outwardly manifest at a definite horizon, pending contextual constraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, wrapping, downward scattering, displacement, and cover-removal successively unsettle the visual coordinate system. This revises الأفق المبين: its clarity need not come from a stable skyline, but can belong to the encounter that remains disclosed while the frame is being dismantled.

activation_trace.role: The far edge is the focus coordinate that the preceding transformations render unstable.
Manifest clarity supplies what persists even when ordinary coordinates no longer do.
Wrapping with gathered layers gives the first celestial coordinate an inward-folding motion and destabilizes the frame.
Scattered downward rush turns fixed points of light into moving debris within the visual field.
Removal and displacement take away another stable landmark and extend the loss of coordinates.
Removing a cover exposes what had been screened and makes disclosure possible through frame-loss itself.

structural_cues: The repeated إذا clauses and passive verbs make cosmic reference points undergo a coordinated sequence before 81:23.
The focus then names a horizon as clear after the surrounding sky has already been represented as removable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coordinated wrapping, scattering, displacement, uncovering, and a clear horizon; I infer that these motions revoke a stable visual frame and transfer clarity to the encounter. A live alternative is that the transformations are only event scenery and do not qualify how the sighting knows.

changed_reading.before: A stable far edge authenticates the sighting by ordinary visibility.
changed_reading.after: The sighting remains manifest at a limit whose cosmic frame is itself collapsing, so clarity belongs to the disclosed encounter rather than to environmental stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning over guilt and killing, followed by written sheets being opened and a self knowing what it has brought present, creates an evidentiary sequence. Within that sequence, رآه and مبين can function as witness and disclosed sign: the horizon sighting becomes a datum that can bear public accounting, not only private experience.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight perception supplies the witnessing act that the accounting sequence can recruit as evidence.
Meaning disclosed by expression or sign lets the clear horizon sighting carry evidentiary content.
Question and demand initiate an inquiry structure into which a witnessed fact can enter.
Guilt or offense supplies the issue being adjudicated rather than a merely curious question.
Taking life supplies the concrete act against which the inquiry and record are measured.
The written sheet supplies a durable record rather than transient recollection.
Opening and spreading turns the record into inspectable evidence.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic result of the inquiry.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness convert what was done into something brought before the knower.

structural_cues: The branchless root و ء د at 81:8 is used only as the structural patient of the passive question; no branch mapping is inferred for it.
Passive questioning and killing lead into opened records, then the active result علمت نفس marks uptake of the evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inquiry, offense, killing, written record, opening, knowing, and presence; I infer a forensic arrow from record disclosure to the later sighting's evidentiary force. Alternatively, the sighting may be credential evidence in a different discourse rather than part of the same accounting chain.

changed_reading.before: The sight at the horizon is a private perceptual episode.
changed_reading.after: The sight can be carried as witnessed evidence within a world where concealed acts are questioned, records are opened, and what was brought becomes known.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retreating, running, hiding, the thin darkness at either end of night, and morning opening like breath form a visibility cycle. This revises الأفق from a fixed spatial line into a temporal aperture whose clarity is produced by withdrawal and emergence.

activation_trace.role: The sky-earth edge supplies the aperture at which concealment can turn into emergence.
Becoming visible gives the aperture its reveal-phase and explains why it is called manifest.
Retreat into concealment supplies the withdrawal phase of the visual cycle.
Flowing motion prevents concealment and appearance from being read as static states.
Celestial disappearance into hiding supplies a concrete off-phase for visibility.
Thin darkness at either edge of night locates transition itself, not full night, as the active interval.
The first light of day supplies the temporal reveal-point at the horizon.
The opening of morning like breath turns disclosure into expansion rather than a light simply switching on.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from celestial retreat and hiding to the two edges of night and then to morning's breath.
The focus sighting follows this oscillation and retains the same celestial field.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, motion, hiding, transitional darkness, first light, and breath-like opening; I infer a conceal-reveal cycle that operates through the horizon. The alternative is that these are separate oath images and the focus horizon remains only spatial.

changed_reading.before: The horizon is a fixed place where an already visible object is seen.
changed_reading.after: The horizon is a timed opening in a moving concealment system, and the seen presence becomes clear as that aperture expands into visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence attaches utterance to an envoy and surrounds him with strength, established capacity, trust, known companionship, and the negation of covered reason. These cues strengthen رآه as credentialing recognition: the visible encounter warrants a chain of speech and agency.

activation_trace.role: Direct perception supplies the eyewitness link by which the described agent can be recognized.
Reflective judgment lets seeing mature into an assessment of identity and reliability.
Articulated speech supplies the payload whose provenance the sighting helps warrant.
Messenger and message supply the transmission relation linking a seen agent to an utterance.
Gathered strength like rope-strands supplies capacity for bearing and conveying the message.
Empowerment and established capacity turn horizon placement into a credentialed station rather than accidental location.
Security and heart-trust supply the reliability conclusion drawn from the recognized envoy.
Sustained companionship supplies a second, social route of recognition alongside the horizon sighting.
The covering of reason names the misclassification explicitly negated, sharpening sight into sane recognition.

structural_cues: Verses 19-23 form a compact chain from saying, to envoy, to capacities and trust, to the known companion, and then to his seeing.
The pronouns create continuity but the packet alone does not force every pronoun to have one referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies utterance, envoy, capacity, trust, companionship, sane reason, and seeing; I infer that the sighting credentials the transmission chain. A live alternative is that the sighted object and the speaking envoy are related by the sequence without being referentially identical.

changed_reading.before: The horizon scene independently reports that someone saw someone.
changed_reading.after: The seeing functions as a recognition credential: a known, reasoning witness visually warrants an empowered and trusted bearer of the utterance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next line couples what is hidden from eyes with the negation of withholding. This revises the clear horizon into a transfer boundary: رآه marks successful reception, الأفق marks the limit crossed, and مبين marks hidden content becoming available rather than hoarded.

activation_trace.role: Showing and making seen supplies the outward movement by which concealed content becomes perceptible.
The far boundary supplies the interface between what lies beyond ordinary vision and what enters it.
Meaning disclosed through sign turns the visual crossing into communicative transfer.
Something screened from eyes supplies the concealed side of the transfer boundary.
Withholding or hoarding, under explicit negation, supplies the blocked action that the disclosure overcomes.

structural_cues: The focus is immediately followed by وما هو على الغيب بضنين, placing visible encounter beside hidden content and non-withholding.
The prepositions بالأفق and على الغيب give the sequence two differently related domains rather than two free themes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies showing, a far edge, sign-disclosure, concealment from eyes, and non-withholding; I infer a directional passage from concealed to perceptible. Alternatively, non-withholding may describe verbal fidelity only, with no spatial force assigned to the horizon.

changed_reading.before: The horizon is simply where the object was visible.
changed_reading.after: The horizon becomes the controlled limit across which what was unavailable to sight is shown and conveyed without being withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rejected saying is paired with distance or rupture and with conjectural speech about the hidden. In contrast, رآه بالأفق المبين offers located perception and manifest discrimination. Seeing therefore acts as an anti-conjectural control on attributed speech.

activation_trace.role: Actual eye-or-insight perception supplies the positive evidentiary mode opposed to unsupported attribution.
Manifest appearance supplies discriminability against conjectural or falsely attributed speech.
Saying what did not occur or falsely attributing it supplies the rejected provenance failure.
Distance and disconnection supply the severed relation assigned to the rejected source.
Conjectural speech about the hidden supplies the epistemic opposite of the located, manifest sighting.

structural_cues: Verses 23-25 alternate positive sight with two وما هو negations concerning hidden transmission and a rejected saying.
The focus alone asserts a completed perceptual act, while the rejected model is formulated as attributed قول.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completed seeing, manifest appearance, false attribution, disconnection, and unseen-guessing; I infer that sight tests the provenance of speech. An alternative is that the negated saying is rejected by authority alone and the horizon sight is only corroborative detail.

changed_reading.before: The sighting adds vividness to a nearby claim.
changed_reading.after: The located, manifest sighting is an epistemic control that separates witnessed transmission from disconnected attribution and guessing about what cannot be seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory initially permits dream vision or a spirit-familiar encounter. The surrounding negations of reason being covered and of a saying attributed to a rebellious distant source weaken that model, but preserve it as the contrast category against which the manifest sighting is defined.

activation_trace.role: Dream vision supplies the first non-ordinary reading that context places under pressure.
A spirit-familiar supplies the stranger mediation model tested by the later source negation.
Manifest appearance keeps the focus reading externally anchored even while its mode is debated.
Covered reason names a madness model under explicit negation and pressures an inwardly disordered account of the vision.
False saying or false attribution identifies a provenance failure that the visionary mediation must avoid.
The rebellious distant spirit-source is explicitly negated and blocks the familiar-mediated reading from becoming primary.

structural_cues: The negation of madness precedes the focus, and the negation of a satanic saying follows it.
The focus itself remains a positive completed sighting at a named external location.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dream and familiar branches at the focus plus explicit madness and spirit-source negations; I infer that context targets a family of non-ordinary misreadings while leaving their rejected outline visible. Alternatively, the negations qualify only speaker and speech, not the perceptual mode of رآه.

changed_reading.before: A liminal dream or familiar-mediated appearance is a coequal possibility within the focus inventory.
changed_reading.after: That possibility survives only as a deliberately evoked contrast: the external, manifest sighting is framed against mental disorder and corrupt spirit-mediated attribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement asks where one is going, names a reminder and guiding mark, then places straightness beside willing. These cues activate the horizon as a bearing: the clear sight does not merely prove a presence but supplies a visible orientation against which movement and volition can be aligned.

activation_trace.role: The horizon's road-face and far edge supply a bearing toward which movement can be measured.
Manifest clarity makes the bearing legible enough to guide rather than merely decorate the view.
Path, destination, and method turn the question of going into an orientation problem.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the corrective signal used to recover a bearing.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the landmark-function transferred to the clear horizon.
Will directed toward an object supplies agency choosing whether to follow the visible bearing.
Straightness, balance, and alignment supply the corrected trajectory produced by the bearing.

structural_cues: The interrogative فأين تذهبون converts the post-sighting discourse into directional address.
The sequence then narrows from a reminder for worlds to whoever wills to become straight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a going-question, reminder, guiding mark, will, and straightness; I infer that the earlier clear horizon acts as their visual bearing. Alternatively, the orientation may derive from the utterance as a whole, with the horizon serving only as evidence for it.

changed_reading.before: The sighting proves what was encountered at a distant edge.
changed_reading.after: The clear edge also becomes a directional landmark: once seen, it calibrates where one goes and whether one's willing movement becomes straight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form names the horizon, while its hide-stage branch is materially remote. It remains packet-anchored because that focus branch meets the nearby sky and explicit skin-removal branch. Render only as an as-if material analogy, never as a replacement gloss for الأفق.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus word الأفق supplies a tanned-hide stage in its own inventory, and مبين supplies exposure or appearance.

activation_trace.role: A hide at a tanning stage gives the focus edge a provisional material image like a worked covering.
Appearance and exposure make the worked edge visible after covering is removed.
The sky as what is raised overhead identifies the covering whose edge the analogy materializes.
Skinning an animal supplies the material action that exposes the edge of the overhead covering.

changed_reading.before: He sees the figure at a geographically clear skyline.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material image, he sees at the exposed edge of an overhead covering being peeled back like worked hide.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This crosses anatomy, cosmology, and time: a horizon is not literally a torso. It remains anchored in the focus horizon's flank branch and in morning's explicit breath and opening. Downstream prose should mark the world-body image as exploratory personification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus horizon inventory includes the flank or side of a body, while the focus adjective marks that side becoming visible.

activation_trace.role: The bodily flank or side gives the horizon an anatomical edge without changing its focus-word anchor.
Becoming visible makes the body-like side open into a manifest field.
First morning places the body-like opening at the temporal edge of darkness.
Breath exiting an interior gives the horizon-flank an outward expansion that releases visibility.

changed_reading.before: The horizon is an inert line illuminated by morning.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the clear horizon is the world's flank expanding with morning breath, and the seen presence appears through that living opening.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because banner and narration lie away from the ordinary inflection of رآه, and one banner comes from the non-dominant split mapping. It remains worth carrying because both mapped inventories independently converge on a visible standard and the context supplies saying and messenger. Render it as an imagistic transmission model, not an identification of the seen referent with a literal flag.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus token رآه resolves to both a dominant seeing inventory with a visible flag branch and a non-dominant relay inventory with narration and banner branches.

activation_trace.role: A flag erected to be seen turns the completed sighting into recognition of a public standard.
Relaying reports and poetry gives the non-dominant mapping a transmission function that can continue beyond the sight.
A second banner image independently converges on the raised-standard mechanism.
The utmost elevated limit supplies the conspicuous station from which the standard can be recognized.
Articulated saying supplies what the standard authorizes and the relay carries.
Messenger and message connect the visible standard to an actual transmission chain.

changed_reading.before: The sighting terminates in the viewer's private recognition of a figure.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory convergence, the horizon sight becomes a raised standard whose recognition authorizes a report and launches it into relay.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This requires two remote branch activations: the non-dominant quenching mapping of رآه and the superior-bucket branch of الأفق. It remains structurally coherent because the context explicitly supplies broad water and filling. Carry it only as a material thought-model for containment and perceptual satiation, not as lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Two focus inventories permit quenching at رآه and a bucket at الأفق, while مبين keeps the proposed rim visibly exposed.

activation_trace.role: Quenching and release from thirst recast perception as reaching visual sufficiency.
The superior bucket gives the horizon a vessel-rim image capable of containing the contextual waters.
Manifest appearance makes the proposed vessel edge optically available rather than hidden.
Broad abundant water supplies the material field held by the vessel analogy.
Filling with water supplies the containment action that makes the horizon readable as a rim.

changed_reading.before: Seeing at the horizon is an optical relation across empty distance.
changed_reading.after: In a deliberately remote material model, the visible horizon is the rim of a filled cosmic vessel and seeing reaches a kind of quenching fullness there.

strongest_changes: The dismantled cosmic frame relocates clarity from a stable skyline to the disclosure event itself.
Question, record, opening, knowledge, and presence turn the sighting into potential witness evidence.
Hiddenness plus non-withholding recasts the horizon as a controlled transfer boundary, while rejected conjectural speech makes seeing a provenance test.
Retreat, hiding, transitional night, and morning breath make the horizon a temporal aperture; the final going and straightness sequence also makes it a bearing.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several coexisting mechanisms: optical proof, reciprocal presentation, maximal-distance discrimination, public credential, temporal opening, forensic witness, hidden-to-visible transfer, and directional calibration. Remote branches also produced contained hide, body, banner-relay, and water-vessel models instead of being silently filtered out.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet's pronoun sequence strongly suggests continuity but does not by itself settle every referent relation.
It remains uncertain how much the clarity of مبين should distribute from the horizon to the whole encounter rather than remain adjectivally local.
Dream, familiar, hide, flank, bucket, quenching, narration, and banner activations are branch-backed but form-distant and must not be promoted into direct glosses.
The directional force may arise from the transmitted saying as a whole rather than specifically from the horizon image.
